nyra-worker-3090ti.display:name: worker-rtx3090ti Shell
nyra-worker-3090ti.description: Direct SSH shell into worker-rtx3090ti. Green tab — inference worker.

blocks.name: worker-rtx3090ti
blocks.cmd: ssh -A -t -o ConnectTimeout=8 worker-rtx3090ti.trex-fiordland.ts.net 'bash -l' || bash

blocks.name: 3090Ti GPU
blocks.cmd: ssh -A -t -o ConnectTimeout=8 worker-rtx3090ti.trex-fiordland.ts.net 'nvidia-smi -l 2' || bash

blocks.name: 3090Ti OpenClaw
blocks.cmd: ssh -A -t -o ConnectTimeout=8 worker-rtx3090ti.trex-fiordland.ts.net 'docker logs -f worker-3090-openclaw 2>&1' || bash

nyra-worker-3060.display:name: worker-rtx3060 Shell
nyra-worker-3060.description: Direct SSH shell into worker-rtx3060. Yellow tab — embeddings + PicoClaw + Ollama.

blocks.name: worker-rtx3060
blocks.cmd: ssh -A -t -o ConnectTimeout=8 worker-rtx3060.trex-fiordland.ts.net 'bash -l' || bash

blocks.name: Ollama Models
blocks.cmd: ssh -A -t -o ConnectTimeout=8 worker-rtx3060.trex-fiordland.ts.net 'curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags | python3 -m json.tool || docker ps' || bash

nyra-oracle-vps.display:name: oracle-vps Shell
nyra-oracle-vps.description: SSH into oracle-vps cloud backend. Blue tab — memory plane, CRM, public ingress.

blocks.name: oracle-vps shell
blocks.cmd: ssh -A -t -o ConnectTimeout=10 oracle-vps.trex-fiordland.ts.net 'bash -l' || bash

blocks.name: Memory Stack
blocks.cmd: ssh -A -t -o ConnectTimeout=10 oracle-vps.trex-fiordland.ts.net 'docker ps --filter name=letta --filter name=mem0 --filter name=qdrant --filter name=falkordb --format "table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}"' || bash

blocks.name: Letta Logs
blocks.cmd: ssh -A -t -o ConnectTimeout=10 oracle-vps.trex-fiordland.ts.net 'docker logs -f nyra-letta --tail 100 2>&1' || bash

blocks.name: mem0 Logs
blocks.cmd: ssh -A -t -o ConnectTimeout=10 oracle-vps.trex-fiordland.ts.net 'docker logs -f nyra-mem0 --tail 100 2>&1' || bash

nyra-orchestrator.display:name: Orchestrator Shell
nyra-orchestrator.description: SSH into orchestrator (Minisforum). Purple tab — LiteLLM, Nexus, llxprt-bridge, WoL.

blocks.name: orchestrator shell
blocks.cmd: ssh -A -t -o ConnectTimeout=8 orchestrator.trex-fiordland.ts.net 'bash -l' || bash

blocks.name: Nexus Router
blocks.cmd: while true; do clear; date; curl -fsS http://orchestrator.trex-fiordland.ts.net:6000/health | python3 -m json.tool 2>/dev/null || echo offline; sleep 5; done

blocks.name: llxprt-bridge
blocks.cmd: while true; do clear; date; curl -fsS http://orchestrator.trex-fiordland.ts.net:8090/health 2>/dev/null || echo offline; sleep 5; done

blocks.name: BitNet
blocks.cmd: while true; do clear; date; curl -fsS http://orchestrator.trex-fiordland.ts.net:8087/health 2>/dev/null || echo offline; sleep 8; done

nyra-gpu-mesh.display:name: GPU Mesh Monitor
nyra-gpu-mesh.description: Live nvidia-smi across all three GPU workers.

blocks.name: RTX5090 [primary]
blocks.cmd: ssh -A -t -o ConnectTimeout=8 worker-rtx5090.trex-fiordland.ts.net 'nvidia-smi -l 2' || bash

blocks.name: RTX3090Ti
blocks.cmd: ssh -A -t -o ConnectTimeout=8 worker-rtx3090ti.trex-fiordland.ts.net 'nvidia-smi -l 2' || bash

blocks.name: RTX3060
blocks.cmd: ssh -A -t -o ConnectTimeout=8 worker-rtx3060.trex-fiordland.ts.net 'nvidia-smi -l 2' || bash

nyra-memory-view.display:name: Memory View
nyra-memory-view.description: Letta agents, mem0 stats, OpenMemory MCP, memOS MCP, and Qdrant collections.

blocks.name: Letta Agents
blocks.cmd: while true; do clear; printf '=== Letta Agents ===\n'; curl -fsS http://oracle-vps.trex-fiordland.ts.net:8283/v1/agents 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool || echo offline; sleep 12; done

blocks.name: mem0 Stats
blocks.cmd: while true; do clear; printf '=== mem0 ===\n'; curl -fsS http://oracle-vps.trex-fiordland.ts.net:5001/v1/memories/stats 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool || curl -fsS http://oracle-vps.trex-fiordland.ts.net:5001/health 2>/dev/null || echo offline; sleep 10; done

blocks.name: OpenMemory + Qdrant
blocks.cmd:
while true; do clear; printf '=== OpenMemory MCP ===
'; curl -fsS http://oracle-vps.trex-fiordland.ts.net:8765/docs 2>/dev/null | head -20 || echo offline; printf '
=== Qdrant Collections ===
'; curl -fsS http://oracle-vps.trex-fiordland.ts.net:6333/collections 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(' ', c['name']) for c in d.get('result',{}).get('collections',[])]" || echo offline; sleep 15; done

blocks.name: memOS MCP
blocks.cmd:
while true; do clear; printf '=== memOS API ===
'; curl -fsS http://oracle-vps.trex-fiordland.ts.net:8001/health 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool || echo offline; printf '
=== memOS MCP ===
'; curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://oracle-vps.trex-fiordland.ts.net:8085/sse 2>/dev/null | head -5 || echo offline; sleep 15; done
